nodes.name: Theorem 2.1: [Proof of ]
nodes.statement:
For every $\phi \in \mathsf{C}^2$,
there exists a Presburger formula $\textsf{PREB}(x)$
such that the set $\{n \mid \textsf{PREB}(n) \ \mbox{holds}\} = \textsc{Spec}(\phi)$.
Moreover, the formula $\textsf{PREB}(x)$ can be constructed effectively.

nodes.name: Theorem 5.7, Theorem 5.9
nodes.statement:
For every two matrices $C \in \mathbb{B}^{\ell\times m}$ and $D \in \mathbb{B}^{\ell\times n}$,
there is a Presburger formula $\textsf{COMP-BiREG}_{C,D}(\bar{X},\bar{Y})$,
where $\bar{X} = (X_1,\ldots,X_m)$ and $\bar{Y} = (Y_1,\ldots,Y_n)$ such that
the following holds.
There exists a $(C,D)$-complete-biregular graph of size $(\bar{M},\bar{N})$
if and only if $\textsf{COMP-BiREG}_{C,D}(\bar{M},\bar{N})$ holds.

For every $C,D \in \mathbb{B}^{\ell\times m}$,
there exists a Presburger formula $\textsf{COMP-REG}_{C,D}(\bar{X})$, where $\bar{X} = (X_1,\ldots,X_m)$
such that the following holds.
There exists a $(C,D)$-complete-regular digraph of size $\bar{N}$
if and only if $\textsf{COMP-REG}_{C,D}(\bar{N})$ holds.
